sloka: बभूव बुद्धिः तु हरि ईश्वरस्य ।यदि ईद्Rशी राघव धर्म पत्नी ।इमा यथा राक्षस राज भार्याः ।सुजातम् अस्य इति हि साधु बुद्धेः ॥५-९-७२॥
transliteration: babhūva buddhiḥ tu hari īśvarasya ।yadi īdRśī rāghava dharma patnī ।imā yathā rākṣasa rāja bhāryāḥ ।sujātam asya iti hi sādhu buddheḥ ॥5-9-72॥

translations.english: 'If the lawful wife of Rama born of a good family can be allowed to remain with Rama in the same way as the consorts of the lord of demons, how fortunate it would be, thought the wise lord of monkeys'.
